title: Hanbit: live dubbing evaluation

sentences.speaker: Ji-woo Park
sentences.text: For live dubbing, the voice has to start within three hundred milliseconds or the sync falls apart.

sentences.speaker: Sam Ito
sentences.text: Our current time to first byte in Asia is roughly six hundred and fifty.

sentences.speaker: Ji-woo Park
sentences.text: Then we can't go live. Also, the seat plan makes no sense for us.

sentences.speaker: Ji-woo Park
sentences.text: Pay-as-you-go per minute. We have huge peaks around events and nothing in between.

sentences.speaker: Priya Raman
sentences.text: I will bring usage-based pricing to our pricing council.

summary: Hanbit blocked on streaming latency (needs under 300 ms TTFB) and wants usage-based per-minute pricing. No contract date.
action_items: Priya to raise usage-based pricing with pricing council
